title: mcp: the open-source draft door — list, read, save and discard metadata drafts, each save answered with the publish verdict
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「三点都同意，按最终计划把后续里程碑的卡全部立出来」, and, on the list of thirteen cards the seat then showed: 「同意」. The ruling records are #34659 comment 6940528935 and #34691 comment 6943107981. Readings: objectstack `a0326b06`, cloud `53a5844`, 2026-11-17.

## Why

On a self-hosted app an AI client can read and write records over MCP and cannot build at all. The ruled design gives it a thin entry: it saves drafts, a person publishes them in Studio. The entry must tell the client at once what a publish would refuse, or the client stages metadata that passes and does nothing.

Who acts: the server lane (`packages/mcp`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol`). Reader: a developer building a self-hosted app with their own AI client.

## Evidence

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts:247-257` passes no `authoring` to `handleHttpRequest`; no open package implements `McpAuthoringToolRegistry` (`packages/mcp/src/types.ts:96-102`). The seam is complete (`mcp-server-runtime.ts:1695-1728`).
- A draft save runs the type's Zod parse and no authoring rule: `AUTHORING_SURFACES = ['cli','runtime-publish']` (`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:186-205`); the gate returns no error when the state is not active (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts:430-445`).
- `draftPublishVerdict` previews the publish verdict of a draft (`protocol-authoring-gate.ts:713`).
- Studio's draft review imports open packages only (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/`).
- Comparable servers: Cube writes to a personal branch ("File writes never touch production"); Neon prepares on a temporary branch, then completes; Directus and Terraform return a machine-followable next step with an error.

## Scope

- An open registry behind `metadata:write`, each tool checking the caller's own `manage_metadata`: `list_metadata`, `get_metadata`, `save_metadata_draft`, `delete_metadata_draft`, `list_drafts`.
- `save_metadata_draft` saves with `mode: 'draft'`, `surface: 'mcp'`, and returns the draft's publish verdict: every finding a publish would raise, each with its rule id, the path, and a next step.
- No publish tool and no `force` (D2 = A). OAuth `metadata:write` only (D3 = A). The reply names the Studio review route.
- Tool names must not collide with the hosted registry's.
- File surface: `packages/mcp/**`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, a read of `packages/metadata-protocol`.

## Done when

- On `examples/app-crm`, an OAuth client with `metadata:write` saves a flow draft whose start node has no routable trigger and gets that finding back in the same reply; the draft appears in Studio's Changes.
- A token without `metadata:write`, and an API key, see none of the five tools.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Rulings: D2, D3, E3 on #34659. Design: `docs/design/mcp-local-first-door.md`, Design A (PR #34675).
- Dedup, open and closed: `MCP draft authoring tools open-source` 1 hit, the parent.
